azure.name: Azure OpenAI
azure.help: Enter your resource URL ending in /openai/v1 and its API key. Use your deployment name as the model ID. Keyless Microsoft Entra authentication is not implemented yet.

xai.name: xAI
xai.help: Use an xAI API key and a chat-compatible model from its catalog. Enable tool calling only for a model that supports it. Usage follows your xAI account.

groq.name: Groq
groq.help: Use a Groq API key and a supported chat model. Free-tier availability and request/token quotas depend on your account; Krono does not provide unlimited cloud usage.

mistral.name: Mistral
mistral.help: Use a Mistral API key and a chat-capable model ID. Model availability, billing and rate limits follow your Mistral account.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.help: Use an OpenRouter key and its exact provider/model ID. Models with a :free suffix still have provider/account limits and availability constraints.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.help: Connect to an existing Ollama server. Install and load a model there first. Local servers without authentication need no key. Model downloads and inference hardware are managed by Ollama.

lmstudio.name: LM Studio
lmstudio.help: Load a model in LM Studio and start its local server. Use its exact model ID. Enter its server token only if authentication is enabled.

custom.name: Custom endpoint
custom.help: Connect to a trusted OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions server. Use HTTPS for remote endpoints; keys are optional only on loopback. Enable tool calling only for a compatible model.
